Hi all,

I know that Omnitron-U has had some bugs with his base power before but I think I found a new one (or 2).

1. AA's Syncopated Onslaught doesn't increase the damage done by Volatile Wiring.

2. Mr. Fixer's Riveting Crane does not make the damage irreducible.

Thanks!

posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
I always think it’s funny how some bugs manifest. Like, why would this one particular instance of damage not get modifiers applied, when in general, damage modifiers apply to…damage?

… I’ve seen plenty of similar things on my own, so I understand that complex systems sometimes have unexpected behaviors. It’s just funny to me HOW they come out sometimes.

posts.cooked: In this case, I'm guessing it's because this is the only instance of damage which is tied to a temporary effect rather than a card in play.

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked: Omnitron-U's power is complicated because as Arcanist Lupus mentions, it is itself based on a temporary effect. The bug was introduced as a side effect of fixing another bug with the power that had to do with Hasty Augmentation.
